_how_to: This file says which key in the owner's questionnaire YAML gives the Risk site each piece of a question. You edit it; nobody needs to change code.

Each list below holds the names the site looks for, best name first. To use a different key from your file, add its name at the START of the list, save, and upload the questionnaire again. The page shows what it read, so you can check it.
Case, spaces, underscores and dashes don't matter: "Switches On", "switches_on" and "switches-on" are the same. A close spelling is matched too, and the page says so.

question_list is where the questions are: a top-level key ("questions") or a path through the file ("form.questions"). If the file itself is a list of questions, it is read as the list. A question list can be a list of questions, or a set of questions keyed by their field. Questions can also sit inside sections, each section holding its own list.

field is the driver field a question feeds, for example RD12 or RD14_pct. It is matched to a driver by the driver's code, its field, or its questionnaire field. A question whose field matches no driver is listed as a problem and left out.

kind is the kind of answer. kind_words lists the words your file may use for each kind: a yes or no, a number, a share (a part of the whole, like 25%), or text (a choice of answers; the choices come from the driver's trigger), or tick_any (several answers can be ticked: MultiSelect, Multiple choice, Checkbox, List; the options come from the file's options list, else from the driver's trigger, written like 'Option A' in get('RD40')). If the file gives no kind, the driver's own rule decides.

switches_on is which answer turns the driver on. For a yes or no question: yes or no. For a number or a share: the number it must reach, such as 3, ">= 3", "at least 3" or "more than 40%". If the file gives none, the driver's own rule is used and the page says so.
section can be a list (tags): the first item is used as the section.

enabled says whether the question is asked. enabled: false leaves it out; if it is already on the site, the load switches it off there (it can be switched back on). A question with no enabled key is asked.
Not every driver needs a question: a driver with no question and no data calculation stays "not known".
options is the list of answers a choice question offers. The driver's trigger decides which answers switch it on; an option the trigger never mentions is listed as a note and counts as Other.
Any key in the file that is not named here is listed on the page as a note and ignored. Nothing is refused for an unknown key.
Keep it valid JSON: names in double quotes, separated by commas. A trailing comma is fine. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
